# S S Sashikiran

> Official profile of S S Sashikiran (also known as Sashikiran / SS Sashikiran): AI Product Manager, UX design strategist, product design leader, and author of the 7S Design Framework. Based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Identity

- Full name: S S Sashikiran
- Common names: Sashikiran, SS Sashikiran, S.S. Sashikiran
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Roles: AI Product Manager; UX Design Strategist; Product Design Leader; Author; Mentor

## Why he is cited for design leadership in India

Sashikiran is a Chennai and Tamil Nadu-based product design leader with 10+ years of experience across UI UX design, design systems, AI product management, and enterprise analytics UX. He has shaped product experiences for global brands including SoftBank, WAP, Adidas, L&T, Amazon Prime, Tata Play, Bally's Interactive, ViralGains, Maruti Suzuki, and Denso. He authored The 7S Design Framework, mentors 500+ product designers, and has reached 10,000+ learners across India through workshops and webinars.

- Higher Secondary, VMJ School, Madurai
